checkpointQuestions.title: Bitmap Photograph Compression
checkpointQuestions.question: Q2
checkpointQuestions.context: A photograph is stored as a bitmap image.
checkpointQuestions.prompt:
(a) The photograph has a resolution of 4000 pixels wide by 3000 pixels high. The bit depth is 4 bytes.

Calculate an estimate for the file size of the photograph in megabytes.

Show your working.

markScheme.criterion: (a) Uses correct file-size method with resolution and bit depth
(a) Correct estimate in megabytes
(b)(i) First valid lossy-compression benefit
(b)(i) Second valid lossy-compression benefit
(b)(i) Third valid lossy-compression benefit
(b)(ii) Explains how RLE encodes repeated runs
(b)(ii) Explains resulting data-size reduction
(c) First valid bitmap element that can be changed
(c) Second valid bitmap element that can be changed
Communication and clarity of technical explanation
Responses remain relevant to bitmap image context

structuredQuestion.title: Bitmap images, file size and compression

checkpointQuestions.title: Image Representation: Bitmap Graphics and Compression
checkpointQuestions.question: Q1
checkpointQuestions.context:
Images are being created to advertise holidays.

Some of the images are bitmap images and some are vector graphics.
checkpointQuestions.prompt: (a) Complete the table by defining the image terms.

markScheme.criterion: Drawing list definition (vector graphics coordinate/path related)
Pixel definition (smallest addressable element/picture element)
Colour depth definition (number of bits used per pixel)
First valid additional file-header item identified
Second valid additional file-header item identified
Correct file-size method and multiplication (1500 x 3000 x bit depth)
Correct MB conversion and final value shown
Explains customer benefit: smaller download size or faster download
Explains customer benefit: lower bandwidth/data usage or storage impact
Reasoning linked to customer perspective clearly
Explains why RLE may fail on images with low repetition/high variation
Explains overhead can offset savings in some cases
Provides a valid example (e.g., detailed/noisy photograph)

structuredQuestion.title: Bitmap Graphics and Compression
structuredQuestion.context:
Images are being created to advertise holidays.

Some of the images are bitmap images and some are vector graphics.

parts.title: Define Image Terms
parts.prompt: (a) Complete the table by defining the image terms.

markScheme.criterion: Drawing list definition (vector graphics coordinate/path related)

parts.context: (b) The bitmap images are photographs of the holiday locations.
parts.prompt:

Identify two other items that could be included in the file header of each photograph.

markScheme.criterion: First valid additional file-header item identified
Second valid additional file-header item identified

parts.context: (b) The bitmap images are photographs of the holiday locations.

Calculate the file size of the photograph in megabytes. Show your working.

parts.context:

parts.context:
